examples.en: A cat shows up in the park at night.
My friend didn't show up at the time we agreed on.
When the sun sets, the stars appear.
If you take the medicine, the effect shows up.

dict_examples.en: An unexpected witness appeared before us, so the situation turned in our favor.
dict_examples.src: 국립국어원 우리말샘 (CC BY-SA 2.0 KR) · 영어: AI 번역

dict_examples.en: The next day, as it got dark, a torch procession began to appear on the street.
dict_examples.src: 국립국어원 우리말샘 (CC BY-SA 2.0 KR) · 영어: AI 번역

explain_en: 나타나다 is for something that was not there and now becomes visible. For a friend arriving at a meeting, 왔어요 is the normal word. 나타났어요 sounds surprised, or like they turned up late.

examples.ko: 공원 입구는 이 길 끝에 있어요.

The ending of the movie was a bit sad.
There's a test at the end of this week.
I'm curious how the story ends.
Where is the restroom? — It's at the end of the hallway.

examples.en: I did some of my homework. I'll do the rest tomorrow.

examples.en: I ate two slices of pizza and put the rest in the fridge.

examples.ko: 이 두 개는 제가 먹고 나머지는 친구한테 줄 거예요.
examples.en: I'll eat these two and give the rest to my friend.
I'll send the rest of the money tomorrow.

examples.ko: 책을 한 권만 읽었어요. 나머지는 아직 못 읽었어요.
examples.en: I've read only one of the books. I haven't been able to read the rest yet.

explain: ‘나머지’는 앞에서 말하고 남은 것 전부를 가리켜요. 수학에서 나누고 남는 수도 ‘나머지’라고 해요.

phrases.en_equiv: staying after class for extra study

dict_examples.ko: 월급에서 생활비를 제외한 나머지는 모두 저축한다.

explain_en: 나머지 means everything that is left after the part you have already mentioned. In math, the remainder after dividing is also called 나머지.

My grades went up a lot this semester.
This semester's grades are out.
My grades were good, so I received a scholarship.
How are your test results? — They're better than last year.

explain_en: 성적 is the overall result and 점수 is the number: 성적이 좋아요 (the results are good), 점수가 구십 점이에요 (the score is 90). It is also used for results at work or in sports.

examples.en: My score on this test was good.
If your score is low, you take the test again.
My test score is ninety.
I want to raise my English score.

examples.ko: 농구 점수가 어떻게 돼요? — 오십 대 사십이에요.
examples.en: What's the score in the basketball game? — It's fifty to forty.

explain: 점수는 한자어 숫자와 ‘점’을 함께 써요: 구십 점, 이 점. ‘아흔 점’이라고 하지 않아요.

When you live alone, you have a lot of freedom.

examples.ko: 기숙사 입구에 상자를 쌓으면 안 돼요.
examples.en: You shouldn't stack boxes at the dorm entrance.
I stacked books high on the desk.
The kids build a sandcastle.

examples.en: I gained a lot of experience over the past year.
When you build trust with each other, it's easier to work.

explain_en: When something piles up by itself, use 쌓이다. When a person does it, use 쌓다: 눈이 쌓여요 (snow piles up), 벽돌을 쌓아요 (I stack bricks).

examples.ko: 오늘은 공원에 안 가요. 왜냐하면 비가 많이 와서요.
examples.en: I'm not going to the park today. Because it's pouring.

examples.ko: 오늘은 일찍 자요. 왜냐하면 내일 시험이 있어서요.
examples.en: I'm going to bed early today. Because I have a test tomorrow.

examples.ko: 저는 커피를 안 마셔요. 왜냐하면 밤에 잠이 안 와서요.
examples.en: I don't drink coffee. That's because I can't sleep at night.

examples.ko: 왜 한국어를 배워요? — 왜냐하면 한국 드라마를 좋아하니까요.
examples.en: Why are you learning Korean? — Because I like Korean dramas.

examples.ko: 저는 이 식당을 좋아해요. 왜냐하면 직원이 친절하기 때문이에요.
examples.en: I like this restaurant. That's because the staff are kind.

explain: 왜냐하면은 앞에 한 말의 이유를 말할 때 써요. 문장 끝은 ‘-아서요’, ‘-니까요’, ‘-기 때문이에요’로 맺어요.

dict_examples.ko: 나는 그의 실패를 탓하지 않았는데 왜냐하면 그는 최선을 다했기 때문이다.
dict_examples.en: I didn't blame him for his failure, because he had done his best.

dict_examples.ko: 고운 말을 쓰는 사람은 마음씨와 몸가짐도 곱다. 왜냐하면 고운 말은 고운 마음씨에서 싹트기 때문이다.
dict_examples.en: A person who uses kind words also has kind manners. That is because kind words sprout from a kind heart.
dict_examples.src: 국립국어원 우리말샘 (CC BY-SA 2.0 KR) · 영어: AI 번역

dict_examples.ko: 물론 그 애는 나의 존재를 모르고 있었다. 왜냐하면, 나는 강당 이쪽 구석에 파묻혀 앉아 있었으니까.
dict_examples.en: Of course he didn't know I existed. That's because I was sitting buried in this corner of the auditorium.
dict_examples.src: 국립국어원 우리말샘 (CC BY-SA 2.0 KR) · 영어: AI 번역

explain_en: 왜냐하면 introduces the reason for what you just said. The sentence usually ends with -아서요, -니까요 or -기 때문이에요.
